text_markup: The Runner, playing as {card:Jesminder Sareen: Girl Behind the Curtain}, steals an agenda during a run on a server with {card:AMAZE Amusements} rezzed in its root. Since {card:AMAZE Amusements}'s ability meets its trigger condition when the run ends, it will become pending in the reaction window following {ref:step_run_complete} and attempt to give the Runner 2 tags. During this window, the run timing structure has closed, and Jesminder's interrupt ability cannot apply to those tags.
